artworks.title: An Apostle Guided by an Angel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures and a cherub-like being. The drawing is executed in a soft reddish-brown medium. On the left, a figure is depicted in profile, holding a staff or walking stick. On the right, another figure is engaged in a dynamic pose, gesturing up towards a small cherub floating above. The cherub is depicted with simplified features and wings. The composition is contained within a rectangular border, emphasizing the figures and their interactions. The minimalist linework suggests it could be a draft or study for a larger work.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered together. The drawing features intricate line work depicting several figures in a loosely composed scene. One central figure is seated with a basket or container in their hands, while other figures appear to be standing and kneeling around. The drawing uses delicate and fluid strokes, enhancing the movement and dynamism within the composition. The absence of any background details focuses all attention on the interactions and attire of the figures themselves, highlighted by a series of quick, expressive lines.

artworks.title: Voltaire
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image is an oval portrait of an elderly man. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his right. His face has deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and curled grey hair that extends to his shoulders. He is dressed in a blue outfit with a fur collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a soft gradient.

artworks.title: A Stream through a Dense Forest
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and gray and black ink
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift in Memory of Melvin R. Seiden
artworks.description: The image is of a rocky woodland opening up to a narrow sunlit river. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dense trees and foliage arching over the waterway and landscape. In the distance, a person on horseback is seen riding the path along the river, which displays bright yellow and blue hues. The painting features detailed brushstrokes defining the branches and rocks, with a rich color palette of earthy tones such as greens, browns, and deep blues, along with golden reflections on the river and autumnal colors in the foliage. The composition conveys a tranquil and secluded atmosphere, highlighting the beauty of the natural surroundings.

artworks.title: Sunset over a Pond
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of gouache on pale gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift in Memory of Melvin R. Seiden

artworks.title: A Boy Holding His Dog
artworks.medium: facsimile with graphite and pen and ink
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a seated person leaning against a large animal, likely a dog. The person is wearing a striped cap and casual clothing. The surroundings are bare, and the sketch is characterized by bold, expressive lines with a sepia tone background.

artworks.title: A Broad Valley at Sunset
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen L. Porter and James T. Dyke

artworks.title: Sunflowers
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image features two large sunflowers with intricate petals and leaves, done in a black and white color palette. One sunflower leans to the left with a drooping head, while the other is more upright with its head turned slightly. The flowers are surrounded by textured leaves, against a simple background.

artworks.title: The Calanque at Saint Tropez
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund

artworks.title: Les Andelys on a Summer Morning
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with graphite on tan paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated perspective looking over a body of water towards distant hills. The horizon aligns with a hilltop featuring a castle-like structure. Tall, stylized trees frame the scene in the foreground, with expressive brushstrokes. Buildings with peaked roofs line the water's edge, contrasting with the natural setting. The color palette is primarily sepia and black, creating a textured look. The water reflects the landscape, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: A Meadow at Sunset
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift in Memory of Melvin R. Seiden
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a landscape with a wide green field extending to a line of dark trees on the horizon. The sky above contains shades of blue, pink, orange, and cream, with a yellow sun setting or rising above the trees. The sun casts a wide yellow strip on the green grass below. The lines of the drawing are rough and textured.

artworks.title: The Embarkation of Aeneas from the Ceraunian Headland
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in dynamic poses. The lines are fluid and convey motion. The central figure appears to be supported by others, while additional figures surround them. The sketchy lines suggest a preliminary study. The figures' proportions and postures show an understanding of anatomy and movement. The background includes architectural elements. Shading and hatching add depth to the figures.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Palace of the White Elephant
artworks.description: The image shows a multi-tiered pagoda with pointed ornaments on each roof level. Near the pagoda, several large cannon-like objects are scattered on the ground. In the background, there are other buildings and a cloudy sky. The color palette is sepia, and the brushstrokes create a grainy texture, reminiscent of an old photograph.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: Another Part of the Balcony of Kyoung No. 86
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an intricately carved building. The image shows the architectural details of the structure, featuring elaborate wooden carvings and ornamental designs. The building is adorned with lattice works, motifs, animals, and mythical creatures, showcasing detailed craftsmanship. A decorative railing is visible at the lower part of the building, while the upper sections display sculptural elements, spires, and decorative panels. The design reflects traditional Southeast Asian architecture, highlighted in great detail in the photograph.

artworks.title: Puerta de Santa Cruz, Toledo
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate stone doorway on a historical building. The photograph shows a detailed facade composed of carved stone, featuring an arched door surrounded by intricate stonework and sculptures. Above the doorway, there are additional decorative elements and carved figures, contributing to the architectural design. The surrounding area includes wrought iron railings and a part of a stone wall.

artworks.title: Two Shepherds beside a Pedestal
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a city nestled in hills, seen from an elevated viewpoint. Mountains, clouds, a pathway leading to an archway with figures, vegetation, and city structures are depicted using detailed etching techniques. The cityscape shows buildings and walls on different elevations under a cloudy sky, with a monochromatic color scheme creating depth and texture through shading.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Cow and Two Sheep
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path, foliage, animals, a person, clouds, a village, trees, mountains, and a sky, all depicted using an etching technique with fine lines and cross-hatching in shades of gray.

artworks.title: Woman with a Donkey Driver
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral landscape with distant hills, a river, a tree, and figures near the water. The composition is detailed with fine brushstrokes, creating texture in the trees and water. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: The Two Great Trees
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large, twisting tree in the foreground. Two small figures are seated on the right, engaged in an interaction. In the background, there are distant trees partially covered by clouds in the sky. The artwork features detailed etched lines, focusing on the figures and trees. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray, black, and white. The landscape recedes into undulating hills leading towards the sky.

artworks.title: Drover with Two Mules
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is in the upper third, partially blocked by a hill with trees. The sky shows linear cloud formations. On the left, a figure tends to a packhorse near a stone bridge. In the middle, two figures sit on a rocky outcrop. The scene is created using monochrome ink, emphasizing textures and contrasts. The colors are limited to black ink on light paper, highlighting the intricate details and balance of the etching.

artworks.title: The Hunter
artworks.medium: complete set of six etchings on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23.2 x 15 cm (9 1/8 x 5 7/8 in.), cut to image
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rugged, rocky terrain and a waterfall. Trees dominate the upper portion, and birds are visible in the sky. The style resembles an etching, with fine lines for textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white for depth. The rocks, stream, cliffs, and trees are detailed in the composition.

artworks.title: Two Goats by the Water
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23 x 14.5 cm (9 1/16 x 5 11/16 in.), cut to image
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. A small pool is formed by waterfalls cascading over rocks, with birds and wildlife nearby. A large tree dominates the center, with a sheer cliff to the right. Figures are seen in the distance near a wooded area. The sky has clouds and subtle horizontal lines. The image is detailed with etching techniques, featuring textures of foliage, rocks, and water. The monochromatic palette enhances the play of light and shadow in the landscape.

artworks.title: The Two Fishermen
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.8 x 14 cm (9 x 5 1/2 in.), cut to image
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rocky terrain and water flowing through it. The horizon is not visible, focusing on the cliffs, trees, and detailed textures created by an etching technique. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes contrast between shadows and light. A body of water reflects the surroundings, and in the distance, craggy rocks, sparse trees, and swirling clouds are visible. The sky has textured details reaching towards the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: A Woman with a Horse and a Standing Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23.5 x 15.1 cm (9 1/4 x 5 15/16 in.), cut to image
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape showing various elements. The horizon is high in the image, with buildings on a ridge under a cloudy sky. The etching is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochrome with black and gray tones. Closest to us, there are figures and animals near water, while the middle ground has rugged terrain and trees. The background has billowing clouds.
